Class TreeNode

java.lang.Object
com.example.sudoku.model.TreeNode
public class TreeNode extends Object
Represents a node in the tree structure used to organize the Sudoku board. Each node can have multiple children and represents either a row or a cell.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Sudoku Team
